_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — bản tiếng Anh của thanso_xu_ly.json (mẫu cố định + lời lưu ý theo lĩnh vực). Ban biên tập viết, chờ người bản xứ duyệt. Câu an toàn dùng đúng lời an_toan.khung_hoang của bộ chặn chung (đường dây nóng quốc tế).

source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. A cultural reference, not a forecast.

mau.an_toan: It sounds like you are carrying something very heavy right now, and I am glad you said it. No card or number can hold this for you, but people can. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number. In the US you can call or text 988; in the UK call Samaritans on 116 123; elsewhere, findahelpline.com lists free lines. Please reach out to one person today — you do not have to carry this alone.
mau.may_rui: Numerology doesn't produce numbers for lotteries, betting or gambling, and this site doesn't give numbers like that. If you like, we can look at what your numbers say about how you make decisions when facing risk.
mau.du_doan_cu_the: Numerology can't answer questions about specific events such as dates and times, life and death, winning and losing, or what someone else will certainly do — anyone who claims they can is making it up. I can help you look at how you are facing this situation through your own numbers.
mau.suc_khoe_the_chat: Numerology doesn't diagnose or predict illness and can't replace a doctor. For questions about physical health, please ask a medical professional. If you like, I can look at what your numbers say about how you react to stress and look after yourself.
mau.tuyen_dung: This site doesn't use numerology to assess, select or reject people for work: there is no evidence that numbers predict ability, and rejecting someone because of their birth date is discrimination. Use a clear job description, a practical test and a structured interview.
mau.can_nguoi_kia: To answer this I need the other person's birth date (and their full name, if you have it). Please enter it in the 'Second person' field. Note: it's best to ask them first before looking them up.
mau.khong_ro: I'm not sure which side of things you're asking about. Could you say a little more — about personality, love, work, family or timing?

luu_y.tai_chinh: This is a cultural lens on money habits, not investment advice. Financial decisions should rest on real figures and qualified people.
luu_y.suc_khoe: This is a cultural lens for self-reflection, not a substitute for a doctor or a mental health professional. If stress goes on for a long time, please see someone qualified. This is not medical advice.
luu_y.quyet_dinh: The numbers don't decide for you. Use them as an open question, then decide based on the real facts of your own situation.
luu_y.thoi_diem: Personal Years, Months and Days are a symbolic rhythm shared by everyone with the same birth day and month, not a prophecy about events.
luu_y.tam_linh: Ideas like karmic debt are the tradition's way of naming a recurring lesson, not a punishment or destiny.
luu_y.ten_goi: Changing your name doesn't change who you are; if you plan to change your legal name, weigh the practical reasons first.
luu_y.con_cai: A child's numbers are only a point of reference; children change a great deal with age and surroundings, so don't let the numbers become a mould.
